subscription_disclosure.title: Subscription terms
bullets: Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.
If you offer a free trial: any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
subscription_disclosure.restore_copy: If you previously purchased a subscription on this Apple ID, tap Restore Purchases to restore access.

app_review.title: App Review Notes
app_review.summary: TalkPilot is a real-time language practice app with speech recognition, translation, AI suggestions, and auto-renewable subscriptions for TalkPilot Pro. The paywall is available from Profile > Upgrade to Pro and may also appear when a signed-in user reaches free usage limits.
items: The app uses auto-renewable subscriptions only. Pricing is shown by the App Store purchase sheet and may vary by region.
Users can review Terms of Service and Privacy Policy in-app from the paywall and through hosted pages at /legal/terms.html and /legal/privacy.html.

The app requests microphone access to support live speaking sessions. Spoken audio may be processed by speech recognition, translation, and AI service providers only to deliver the requested real-time features.

The app may process and store transcripts, generated suggestions, review results, and session metadata when needed to provide conversation history, account sync, customer support, security, or feature continuity.
Private conversation content is not used for model training by default unless we clearly disclose otherwise and obtain any required consent.
Users can initiate account deletion in-app at Settings > Account > Delete Account, and they can still send privacy requests by email at lihao15510558202@gmail.com.
Restore Purchases is available on the paywall for users who previously subscribed with the same Apple ID.
Subscription management is available through the in-app customer center and through Apple account subscription settings.
A signed-in account is required before purchase so subscription access can sync correctly across sessions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using TalkPilot.

sections.title: 1. About TalkPilot
sections.body: TalkPilot is a language practice app that helps you improve spoken English with real-time speech recognition, translation, AI suggestions, and related support features. These Terms govern your access to and use of the app and related services.

sections.title: 2. Accounts
sections.body: Some features require you to sign in. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide, the security of your device, and activity that occurs through your account or anonymous app session.

sections.title: 3. Microphone, speech, and AI features
sections.body: TalkPilot requests microphone access so you can start live speaking sessions. Before these features begin, the app shows an in-app notice asking for your permission to send the required voice and text data. When you choose to use speech, translation, or AI features, your audio, transcripts, conversation text, and related prompts may be processed by TalkPilot and service providers such as Deepgram (speech recognition), Cerebras or Together AI (AI suggestions and review), Google Cloud Translation when enabled, and Supabase-hosted backend services that deliver the requested feature. If you do not want this processing, do not start those features.

sections.title: 4. Conversation content and storage
sections.body: Depending on the feature you use, TalkPilot may process or store conversation transcripts, generated replies, review results, session metadata, and limited local voice samples so the app can provide history, session continuity, account sync, debugging, fraud prevention, and customer support. Some processing may be transient, while some data may remain associated with your account or device until deleted or no longer needed.

sections.title: 5. Model training and product improvement
sections.body: Unless we clearly disclose otherwise and obtain any required consent, we do not use your private conversation content to train our own foundation models. We may use de-identified operational metrics, error information, and aggregate usage patterns to improve reliability, abuse prevention, and product performance.

sections.title: 6. AI output limitations
sections.body: AI-generated suggestions, translations, and reviews may be incomplete, inaccurate, offensive, or unsuitable for your situation. You remain responsible for how you use any output from TalkPilot, especially in legal, medical, financial, employment, safety, or other high-risk situations.

sections.title: 7. Subscriptions
sections.body: TalkPilot may offer a paid subscription that unlocks premium features. Subscription payments and renewals are processed by the App Store. Prices and availability may vary by region and are shown in the purchase flow.

sections.title: 8. Billing, renewal, and cancellation
sections.body: Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Refunds are handled according to App Store policies.

sections.title: 9. Restore purchases
sections.body: If you reinstall the app or switch devices, you may restore eligible purchases tied to your Apple ID by using the Restore Purchases option in the app. Restoration requires an internet connection and may take time to sync.

sections.title: 10. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the app, attempt to disrupt the service, reverse engineer the app, or access the service in an unauthorized way.

sections.title: 11. Privacy and data requests
sections.body: If you want to access, correct, delete, or inquire about your personal data, you can use the in-app account deletion flow at Settings > Account > Delete Account, or contact us at lihao15510558202@gmail.com for other privacy requests. We may need to verify your request before taking action.

sections.title: 12. Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about these Terms, privacy practices, subscriptions, or billing, contact us at: lihao15510558202@gmail.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: This Privacy Policy explains how TalkPilot collects and uses information.

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information needed to operate TalkPilot, including account identifiers such as a user ID, subscription status, app diagnostics, device and usage metadata, and content you choose to submit through speech, text, or support requests.

sections.title: 2. Microphone permission and voice data
sections.body: TalkPilot requests microphone permission so you can join live speaking sessions. When you actively use those features, we may process spoken audio to perform speech recognition, translation, voice playback, and related AI assistance. The app presents an in-app consent notice before these features start sending data for processing. If microphone permission is denied, those features will not work.

sections.title: 3. Text, transcripts, and conversation content
sections.body: Your speech may be converted into text, translated, summarized, reviewed, or used to generate reply suggestions. We may process or store transcripts, generated suggestions, review output, and session records when needed to deliver real-time features, provide conversation history, sync your account, investigate problems, enforce our terms, or support customer requests. Depending on the feature route in use, this processing may involve Deepgram, Cerebras, Together AI, Google Cloud Translation, and Supabase-hosted backend services.

sections.title: 4. How we use information
sections.body: We use information to authenticate users, provide speech recognition, translation, AI assistance, restore purchases, maintain security, provide customer support, monitor service quality, and improve reliability.

sections.title: 5. Analytics and diagnostics
sections.body: We may collect app analytics and operational diagnostics, such as app version, runtime version, feature state, and error metadata, to understand product usage and improve stability. By default, we do not include raw private conversation text in our analytics events unless a future feature clearly says otherwise.

sections.title: 6. Service providers
sections.body: We may use service providers to help run the app, such as the App Store for billing, RevenueCat for subscription management, Supabase and related backend infrastructure, analytics providers, Deepgram for speech recognition, Cerebras and Together AI for AI-generated suggestions and review, and Google Cloud Translation when that translation route is enabled. These providers process content only as needed to deliver the feature you requested.

sections.title: 7. Model training
sections.body: Unless we clearly disclose otherwise and obtain any required consent, we do not use your private conversation content to train our own foundation models. If this practice changes for any feature, we will update this policy and the relevant product notice before applying that change.

sections.title: 8. Data retention
sections.body: We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the service, maintain account history, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and protect the service. Different categories of data may be kept for different periods depending on their purpose.

sections.title: 9. Your choices and deletion requests
sections.body: You can manage subscriptions in your App Store account settings. You can also delete your TalkPilot account in-app at Settings > Account > Delete Account, or request access, correction, or other privacy support by emailing lihao15510558202@gmail.com. We may need additional information to verify your request before we act on it.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: For questions about this Privacy Policy, privacy requests, or data handling practices, contact: lihao15510558202@gmail.com
